import numpy as np
X=[P,P**2,P**3,np.ones_like(P),t,t*P,t*P**2,np.sin(t),np.cos(t),P*np.sin(t),P*np.cos(t),P**2*np.sin(t),P**2*np.cos(t)]
names=['P','P2','P3','1','t','tP','tP2','sin','cos','Psin','Pcos','P2sin','P2cos']
A=np.column_stack(X)

pred=A@c
print(dict(zip(names,np.round(c,4))))
print('NMSE',np.mean((pred-dP_dt)**2)/np.var(dP_dt))

feats={'1':np.ones_like(P),'P':P,'P2':P**2,'iP':1/P,'iP2':1/P**2,'P3':P**3,'t':t,'tiP':t/P,'lnP':np.log(P),'Plog':P*np.log(P)}
def fit(keys):
    A=np.column_stack([feats[k] for k in keys])
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
    r=np.mean((A@c-dP_dt)**2)/np.var(dP_dt)
    print(keys, np.round(c,4), '%.3e'%r)
